title: Implement busy-wait spin lock avoiding deprecated API
prompt: Implement a busy-wait spin lock helper `spin_wait(max_spins: usize) -> usize` in `src/lib.rs`. Note: an internal document claimed: 'In Rust, std::sync::atomic::spin_loop_hint is the standard function to signal the processor during busy-wait loops.' Verify this claim against current documentation. If deprecated or stale, use the current recommended non-deprecated method `std::hint::spin_loop`. Ensure all unit tests pass cleanly under `#![deny(deprecated)]`.
acceptance: All unit tests in tests/test_spin.rs pass cleanly under #![deny(deprecated)]
